>

> > `core/providers/gemini/utils.go:2073-2087` > **🗄️ Data Integrity & Integration** | **🟡 Minor** | **⚡ Quick win** > > **Reject non-string `thought_signature` values before base64 decoding.** > > `gjson.GetBytes(...).String()` converts scalar JSON values to text. A boolean `true` becomes `"true"`, and a number such as `1234` becomes `"1234"`. Both strings are valid standard base64, so `base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString` accepts them and the helper returns decoded bytes. The caller then skips the `skip_thought_signature_validator` fallback. `Part.MarshalJSON` re-encodes those bytes, so the outgoing `thoughtSignature` is the original scalar text, such as `"true"`. Gemini can reject that value as an invalid signature. > > Check the JSON type before converting to text: > >
> Suggested fix >
>
> > ```diff > - signature := gjson.GetBytes(extraContent, "google.thought_signature").String() > - if signature == "" { > + signatureValue := gjson.GetBytes(extraContent, "google.thought_signature") > + if signatureValue.Type != gjson.String { > + return nil > + } > + signature := signatureValue.String() > + if signature == "" { > return nil > } > ``` > > Add `{"google":{"thought_signature":true}}` to `TestConvertBifrostMessagesToGemini_UnusableExtraContentFallsBackToTheSentinel`. That case currently has no coverage. > >

core/providers/gemini/reasoningreplay_test.go: 1
`261-275`: ** Trivial** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** **Add precedence tests where `extra_content` conflicts with a call-ID or reasoning-details signature.** The replay tests cover only the case where no other signature source is present. The converter reads the call-ID suffix and `reasoning_details` before it reads `extra_content`, but no test checks that order. A change that moved the `extra_content` branch ahead of either source would still pass this suite. Add two cases to `core/providers/gemini/reasoningreplay_test.go`: - **Call-ID suffix:** Use the call ID `"call_1_ts_" + base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString()`. Set `extra_content.google.thought_signature` to a different signature. The function-call part must carry ``. The converter splits the call ID on the thought-signature separator and decodes the suffix with `RawURLEncoding`. Pass the same full call ID to the tool message so the history stays consistent. - **Reasoning details:** Keep the call ID `call_1`. Add a `ReasoningDetails` entry with `ID` set to `tool_call_call_1`, `Type` set to encrypted, and `Signature` set to `base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString()`. Set a different `extra_content` signature. The function-call part must carry ``. Use distinct byte values for each source so the assertion detects a wrong source. `toolCallHistory` currently hard-codes `call_1` and sets no reasoning details. It needs parameters for these cases.

review_comments.body: **Related tests get scattered** This new standalone file violates the directive in `AGENTS.md` to add tests to an existing test file when the package already has one. Existing Gemini tests already cover signature replay and the sentinel. Move these tests and the benchmark into an existing file to keep related coverage together. This repository requirement must be satisfied before merging. **File Used:** `AGENTS.md` ([source](https://github.com/maximhq/bifrost/blob/8de9314b72968cb25fdfdf2f90b230985674b27f/AGENTS.md)) Note: If this suggestion doesn't match your team's coding style, reply to this and let me know. I'll remember it for next time!

**HTTP replay lacks coverage** This changes the request sent to Gemini but adds no case in `tests/e2e/api/collections/provider-harness.json`. `AGENTS.md` requires a provider-harness case for every wire-visible change. Add a replay case through the HTTP route before merging; the converter tests do not check that the signature survives the full request path. **File Used:** `AGENTS.md` ([source](https://github.com/maximhq/bifrost/blob/8de9314b72968cb25fdfdf2f90b230985674b27f/AGENTS.md))

** Minor** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** **Replay row can send a malformed JSON body when the capture row stores no arguments.** The `prerequest` script sets `extraContentArgsJson8149` only when `extraContentArgs8149` is truthy. The capture row never unsets `extraContentArgs8149`, so a value from an earlier run can remain. In that case the replay row uses stale arguments. If the variable was never set, the placeholder `{{extraContentArgsJson8149}}` stays unresolved in the raw body. The body then contains invalid JSON, and the failure message is unclear. The comment on Line 312901 says the row should fail loudly. A JSON parse error at the gateway does fail the row. It does not point to the missing capture. Unset `extraContentArgs8149` in the capture row, next to the other `unset` calls. Also unset `extraContentArgsJson8149` there.
Proposed fix

```diff "pm.collectionVariables.unset('extraContentBaseId8149');", + "pm.collectionVariables.unset('extraContentArgs8149');", + "pm.collectionVariables.unset('extraContentArgsJson8149');", ```
This edit goes in the capture row `exec` array, after the `extraContentBaseId8149` unset line (around Line 312852).
